title: Obere Regenstraße, Regensburg
description:
Directly on the river Regen with views of the stunning Regensburg old city from your doorstep - this cosy one-room flat is newly renovated (completed November 2025) with a brand-new bathroom including an enclosed shower, professionally designed and installed kitchen and beautifully stylish floors.

The flat is fully furnished with everything you need for a highly comfortable short to medium-term stay. The smartly equipped and separated kitchen includes a microwave with a grill-function, a full-sized fridge and plenty of storage space. A convenient feature window can be used as a coffee station as well as enabling food to be served into the main room.

The main room includes a bed (140cm) with build-in drawers, a wardrobe, a wall-mounted Smart TV, a height-adjustable desk and a cosy reading nook.


Situated in a vibrant neighborhood with its own cult indie cinema and local & international cuisine
By the junction of the Regen & Danube rivers, with scenic walking, running & cycling routes and a popular swimming spot at your doorstep
5-min bike ride to Stadtamhof (highly popular restaurant & cafe strip) and the Old Stone Bridge leading to the city centre
120m to the number 3 bus stop to Regensburg HBF
400m to the nearest supermarket
1 km from the Alex Center, featuring all essential stores and a library
1.5 km from the Donau-Einkaufszentrum, a major shopping centre
Less than 1 km to McFit Gym and other fitness/yoga studios
700m from the MR offices

title: Würmstraße, Regensburg
description:
Spacious 28 m2 Room with Balcony – Double Occupancy – Regensburg

A bright and spacious 28 m2 furnished room with a private balcony, ideal for two students or friends sharing a room.

The room is equipped with:

🛏️ Two comfortable single beds, which can also be combined into one double bed
👔 Two large wardrobes with mirrors
💻 Height-adjustable desk
🪑 Office chair
🌿 Private balcony

Rent: €450 per person/month
→ €900/month for the entire room for two people

The apartment

The room is part of a spacious 116 m2 furnished shared apartment with everything you need for a comfortable stay in Regensburg, including:

Kitchen with stove, oven, refrigerator and dishwasher
Washing machine
Shared living areas
Modern bathroom facilities
Wi-Fi
Furnished common areas

The apartment is particularly suitable for international students, language-course students and young professionals looking for a comfortable and hassle-free place to stay in Regensburg.

The room is intended for double occupancy.
